Effects of Eupatilin Supplementation on Porcine Oocyte Maturation during IVM To investigate the impact of eupatilin supplementation on porcine oocyte quality during IVM, COCs were cultured with varying concentrations of eupatilin (0.01, 0.1, and 1 uM). At the end of IVM, evaluations were conducted on the cumulus expansion status, PBE rate, and gene expression in porcine oocytes.
